The 30 September digest says Mateo submitted ticket #8841, for Dock Door 14 at the Newark facility. Drivers on the second shift couldn't select Door 14 on the check-in kiosk, and you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

I'd check that number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you'd closed #8841 with support. That one was the Detention Summary CSV export and kiosk tablet cache issue. The digest may have the wrong number, or the number may have been reused. I can't see the ticket records themselves, so I can't tell which it is. Please confirm in the ticketing system, or ask Mateo for the number he was given.
